panels.description: Connected users/peers by source country across sing-box, xray, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, and Conduit's relayed clients (region=country). A reach view, not bytes. Top 20.

panels.title: Bytes by destination port
panels.description: Destination ports. Colours match the protocol pie. Top 14.

panels.title: Bytes by protocol (from port)
panels.description: Same bytes, ports mapped to their well-known protocol (443=HTTPS, 53=DNS, 853=DoT, ...). Colours match the port pie. Unmapped ports fold into 'other'.

options.content: **Destination data — the sites, ports, protocols and destination countries on this dashboard — is observed by the sing-box exporter only.** Other protocol engines (xray, WireGuard, AmneziaWG, Telegram, Snowflake, Conduit) do not emit per-destination metrics, so destinations reflect sing-box traffic. Sites are k-anonymised: those under `SITE_ANALYTICS_MIN_CLIENTS` distinct clients fold into `other`; no client identifier is ever stored.

panels.title: Share of traffic by site
panels.description: Bytes per destination site. 'other' = folded (< k clients).

panels.title: Distinct clients per named site
panels.description: How many distinct clients reached each NAMED site (sites over the k-anonymity floor). Sites below the floor are hidden in 'other' and not shown here.

panels.title: Traffic by destination country
panels.description: Destination geography (sing-box). 'unknown' is the coverage gap by design.
